name: HPAY
fix_description: Add onlyOwner modifier to setToken(). Currently anyone can call it to change the staking and rewards token addresses to a malicious token, then drain the contract funds.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a straightforward logic flaw: the attacker can call an unprotected token configuration function, point the staking contract to a self-minted fake token, stake arbitrary amounts, wait, then switch back to the real reward token and withdraw. It requires only a few simple steps, no flash loans or deep DeFi mechanics, and the PoC is short and direct.
